reader1.note: Per-language tree-sitter parsers emit Symbol records with name, SymbolKind, file_path and Range (start/end line) stored in the Tantivy index.

reader2.note: Per-language tree-sitter parsers emit RawSymbol/Symbol records with name, kind, file and Range (start/end line).

reader1.note: About 15 languages (rust, python, ts, js, go, c, cpp, java, kotlin, swift, php, lua, csharp, clojure, gdscript), each a LanguageDefinition registered in one registry.

reader2.note: Registry dispatches 15 languages (rust, python, ts, js, go, java, c, cpp, csharp, kotlin, swift, php, lua, clojure, gdscript), each with its own parser module.

reader1.note: Symbol has signature and doc_comment fields filled by the parsers.

reader2.note: Symbol has signature and doc_comment fields filled by the parsers.

reader1.note: Visibility (public/crate/module/private) is parsed and stored per symbol; async/static modifiers are not recorded as fields.

reader2.note: Visibility is set by each parser, persisted in the index, and used by language behaviours in symbol visibility/import resolution; async/static not recorded.

reader1.searched: grep -rniE is_test|test_attr|#\[test|_test\.|\.test\. over src/parsing, src/indexing, src/storage, src/symbol, src/mcp; only unit-test code and a registry test hit, no tagging of symbols as tests
reader1.note: Symbols carry no test flag and no parser or query tags test functions or files.

reader2.searched: grep -rniE "is_test|test_file|#[test]|skip_tests|include_tests" over src/parsing, src/mcp, src/indexing, src/symbol, src/storage, src/cli
reader2.note: No code tags symbols or files as tests; only test modules of the project itself match.

reader1.note: Calls relationships are resolved to (from_id,to_id) pairs and queried both ways by get_calls and find_callers (CLI retrieve calls/callers).

reader2.note: Calls/CalledBy relationships are stored and queried via find_callers and get_calls.

reader1.note: Import records (path, alias, glob, type-only) are stored per file and used for resolution; there is no dedicated who-imports-this query tool.

reader2.note: Per-file import records (file id, import path, alias) are stored and used in resolution; no file-to-file edge query is exposed.

reader1.note: Extends and Implements relations are stored and read by the retrieve implementations command and analyze_impact.

reader2.note: Extends/Implements (and inverse) relations are stored and returned by get_dependencies and analyze_impact; dump can filter them.

reader1.note: The resolve stage picks among name candidates using file, language, imports and module path via LanguageBehavior::import_matches_symbol, linking calls to definitions in other files.

reader2.note: Resolve stage links calls to definitions using per-language import resolution, receiver type inference and scope context.

reader1.searched: grep -rniE louvain|leiden|community|connected_component|modularity over src/; src/vector/clustering.rs is K-means for IVFFlat vector indexing, not a graph module detector
reader1.note: No graph-based clustering of symbols or files into modules; only K-means over embeddings for the vector index.

reader2.searched: grep -rniE "louvain|leiden|communit|connected_comp|tarjan|petgraph|scc" over src and Cargo.toml; src/vector/clustering.rs inspected
reader2.note: Only K-means over embeddings for the IVFFlat vector index exists; no module/community clustering of symbols.

reader1.note: Uses/UsedBy and References relation kinds are stored for type usage and read by analyze_impact.

reader2.note: Uses/UsedBy, References and Defines edges (type usage, composition) are stored and returned by analyze_impact.

reader1.note: Tantivy full-text index over symbol name, doc and signature queried by search_symbols and the CLI retrieve search.

reader2.note: Tantivy full-text index over name, doc_comment, signature and context, queried by search_symbols and the retrieve command.

reader1.note: fastembed ONNX embeddings of doc comments with nearest-neighbour search, exposed as semantic_search_docs.

reader2.note: Doc-comment embeddings (ONNX/fastembed) with a vector nearest-neighbour search behind semantic_search_docs.

reader1.note: A 3-10 gram name_text field supports partial and substring name matching ranked by Tantivy; no edit-distance.

reader2.note: FuzzyTermQuery (edit distance 1) plus 3-10 ngram tokenizer on name_text for partial matching.

reader1.searched: grep -rniE regex|Regex|ast-grep|structural over src/mcp, src/cli, src/storage/tantivy/query.rs; search_symbols takes a plain full-text query
reader1.note: Search takes words/ngrams and kind/module filters only; no regex or AST-shaped pattern command.

reader2.searched: grep -rniE "regex|RegexQuery|ast.?grep|structural" over src/mcp, src/storage, src/cli, src/retrieve.rs
reader2.note: No regex or syntax-pattern search command; search_symbols takes tantivy text queries only.

reader1.note: codanna serve starts an MCP server (stdio, or http/https) exposing find_symbol, get_calls, find_callers, analyze_impact and search tools.

reader2.note: codanna serve runs an rmcp MCP server (stdio or HTTP/HTTPS) exposing find_symbol, search_symbols, find_callers, etc.

reader1.note: A clap Commands enum with index, retrieve (symbol/calls/callers/search/describe), serve, mcp and others printing results.

reader2.note: clap subcommands init, index, retrieve, dump, mcp, serve and others print results.

reader1.note: serve --http binds an axum server (default feature http-server) that answers MCP tool queries; no graph visual UI.

reader2.note: An axum HTTP server serves MCP, OAuth and /health; it does not answer graph queries over REST or serve a browser view (the graph view is a standalone HTML file from a skill).

reader1.note: Plugin/profile installer that installs Claude agent hooks, commands and agents that call codanna.

reader2.note: codanna plugin installer installs Claude Code plugins (commands, agents, hooks, MCP) and ships a codanna-toolset plugin that calls the tool.

reader1.note: add-dir/remove-dir/list-dirs register several indexed directories in one index; there is no per-repo name registry or per-repo selection in queries.

reader2.note: Several directories are added to one index (add-dir); no named repo registry or per-repo selection in queries.

reader1.note: File content is hashed and compared with the stored hash so only new or modified files are re-indexed, with caller invalidation.

reader2.note: Discover stage compares content hashes to find modified, new and deleted files and re-indexes only those plus invalidated callers.

reader1.note: notify-based unified watcher re-indexes changed files; serve --watch also hot-reloads the index.

reader2.note: notify-based unified watcher with debouncing re-indexes code, config and document changes (enabled by serve --watch/config).

reader1.note: WalkBuilder honours .gitignore chains and .codannaignore plus configured ignore patterns.

reader2.note: ignore::WalkBuilder honours .gitignore chains and .codannaignore; configured ignore patterns also apply.

reader1.note: codanna dump writes the resolved graph as JSON Lines (symbol and relationship rows), also --json output on retrieve.

reader2.note: codanna dump streams all symbols and relationships as JSON Lines with kind filters.

reader1.searched: grep -rniE mermaid|digraph|graphviz|\.dot|svg|d3 over src/ and examples/; only dump_edges.rs example prints edges
reader1.note: No DOT, Mermaid, SVG or HTML graph emission.

reader2.note: Skill scripts turn a codanna dump into a self-contained interactive HTML graph (not in the Rust binary).

reader1.note: analyze_impact walks relationships backwards (calls, type usage, composition) from a symbol to affected symbols.

reader2.note: Walks reverse relationships (callers, type users, composers) transitively from a symbol to its dependants.

reader1.searched: grep -rniE "git diff|diff --|pull.request|hunk" over src/ (only git.rs for clone of plugins); mcp/tools list: find_symbol, get_calls, find_callers, analyze_impact, search_*
reader1.note: No code reads a git diff or PR to map changed lines to symbols.

reader2.searched: grep -rniE "git diff|"diff"|pr_context|changed.?lines|hunk" over src (src/git.rs only wraps clone/pull for plugin installs)
reader2.note: No code reads a diff or PR and maps changed lines to symbols.

reader1.searched: grep -rniE "dead.code|unreferenced|unused|circular|cycle" over src/ (hits are comments or reload cycles); mcp tools and cli commands listed, none for it
reader1.note: No query for symbols without inbound edges or import cycles.

reader2.searched: grep -rniE "dead|unused|unreferenced|orphan|cycle|circular" over src/mcp, src/cli, src/indexing, src/relationship
reader2.note: No dead-code or cycle query; only unrelated "dead process" lock handling matched.

reader1.searched: grep -rniE "cyclomatic|complexity|churn|loc\b" over src/; hits are prose comments in parser.rs and documents/store.rs
reader1.note: No per-symbol metric is computed.

reader2.searched: grep -rniE "complexity|cyclomatic|churn|hotspot|loc" over src (only a type-alias comment and kmeans docs matched)
reader2.note: No per-symbol or per-file metric such as complexity or churn is computed.

reader1.note: semantic_search_with_context returns docs, callers, callees and impact for each hit in one call, bounded by a result limit rather than a token budget.

reader2.note: One call returns matching symbols with docs, callers, callees and impact graph, bounded by a result limit and score threshold but not a token budget.
